q: Wasulan Hausa guda nawa ne a tsaye (Standard vowels)?
explanation: Standard Hausa has five basic vowels: a, e, i, o, u.

q: Wanne ne cikin wadannan bakari (consonant) ne mai daka (glottalized)?
explanation: B' is a glottalized (recursive) consonant in Hausa phonology, distinct from the plain 'B'.

q: Kalmar 'Guda' a cikin lissafi tana nufin _____.
explanation: 'Guda' acts as a counter for individual units or items.

q: Wanne ne 'wakilin suna' (pronoun) na nuni na kusa?
explanation: 'Wannan' (this) is used to point at items that are close to the speaker.

q: Kammala karin maganar nan: 'Kowa ya bar gida, _____.'
explanation: This is a common proverb meaning if you abandon your origins, they will eventually abandon you.

explanation: A 'Makiri' is a blacksmith who works with iron and fire.

q: Wanne ne 'fi'ili' (verb) a cikin wannan jimlar: 'Yarinya tana gudu'?
explanation: 'Gudu' (running) is the action word in the sentence.

q: A wanne bangare na 'Adabin Baka' ake samun Gizo da Kura?
explanation: Gizo (spider) and Kura (hyena) are central characters in Hausa folktales (Tatsuniya).

q: Littafin 'Magana Jari Ce' wane ne ya rubuta shi?
explanation: Dr. Abubakar Imam is the author of this famous Hausa literary classic.

content: Kimanin shekaru biyu da suka gabata, duniya ta fuskanci wani babban kalubale na rashin lafiya wanda ya samo asali daga kwayar cutar Coronavirus. Wannan cuta ta yi sanadiyyar mutuwar miliyoyin mutane tare da durkusar da tattalin arzikin kasashe da dama. Gwamnatoci sun sanya dokar kulle domin rage yaduwar cutar. An kuma bukaci jama'a da su rika wanke hannu da sabulu da kuma sanya takunkumin fuska. A yanzu, an samar da rigakafi wanda ya taimaka wajen daidaita lamura.

questions.explanation: The entire passage focuses on the history and impact of the Coronavirus pandemic.

questions.q: Menene babban tasirin cutar ga kasashen duniya?
questions.explanation: The passage mentions it caused the economy to collapse ('durkusar da tattalin arziki').

questions.q: Wace hanya ce aka ambata domin kariya daga cutar?

questions.explanation: It states that vaccination ('rigakafi') helped stabilize the situation.

content: Kasar Hausa tana da dadadden tarihi na al'adu da sana'o'i. Kafin zuwan Turawa, Hausawa sun kware a fannin noma da kira da fatauci. Harshen Hausa ya bazu ko'ina a yammacin Afirka saboda kasuwanci. A yau, an inganta harshen ta hanyar rubutu da amfani da shi a kafafen yada labarai na duniya irin su BBC da VOA da China Radio International.

questions.q: Me ya sa harshen Hausa ya bazu ko'ina?
questions.explanation: The passage says the language spread because of trade ('saboda kasuwanci').

questions.q: Wanne ne cikin kafafen yada labarai aka ambata?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly mentions the BBC.

questions.q: Sana'o'i nawa aka ambata a farkon passage din?
questions.explanation: The passage mentions Noma (farming), Kira (blacksmithing), and Fatauci (trading) - three trades.
Fatauci refers to commercial expeditions or trading trips.

questions.q: Me aka yi wa harshen a yau?
questions.explanation: The passage states it has been improved ('an inganta shi') through writing and media.
